mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals stronger economic demand, which lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: expanding economy with steady GDP growth
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained GDP growth, or GDP growth decelerates in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6.5% triggers increased labor market confidence, boosting corporate earnings expectations and S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05) despite the unemployment rate crossing the 6.5% threshold, or the rate recovers within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates conflicting signals, but in this regime of accommodative policy, robust GDP growth offsets tightening, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 0.10 and GDPC1 growth in Q2 2013 is positive
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 0.10 and GDPC1 growth in Q2 2013 being positive, or FEDFUNDS rise above 0.10 in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with CPIAUCSL below 2%, sustained low inflation and strong economic momentum signal continued growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite CPIAUCSL remaining below 2.0, or inflation rises above 2.0 in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the supply index (INDPRO) reflects robust production capacity, lowering price pressures and boosting investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained growth in INDPRO, or supply growth decelerates in Q3 2013.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in industrial output (HOUST) above 900 units signals strong demand for goods, driving up corporate profits and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite HOUST exceeding 900 units, or the surge reverses in Q3 2013.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor demand (PAYEMS) and economic activity (RSAFS) both increasing signal a healthy labor market and robust demand, amplifying positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both PAYEMS and RSAFS rising above their July 2013 levels, or one series rises while the other does not.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening monetary cycle with FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5%, investors anticipate higher interest rates, leading to short-term market volatility but ultimately negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5%, or the rate remains below 4.5% in the following month.
